findings.summary: No committed test covers an UNKNOWN write or crash recovery for a run linked to a conversation; a throwaway probe showed the link is kept, the next message is refused while NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, and after reconcile the next run carries it.
The fixed refusal hint 'wait, decide the approval, or stop' also applies under NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, where stopping does not unblock the conversation; a note on ADR 0023 section 4.
Conversation updated_at uses the wall clock while created_at uses the kernel clock; ordering is by created_at.
The runs_by_conversation index does not cover the run_id tie-break; ordering stays correct.
list_conversations makes one list_conversation_runs call per conversation and loads full run records (N+1); correct but slow.
